summary: SiteDocument is a data entity representing a document associated with a site. It has a unique identifier and is linked to a site via SiteID.
purpose: To model and manage documents associated with sites. Used primarily for referencing and organizing site-related documents in the application.

entities.name: SiteDocument
entities.description: Represents a document linked to a specific site.

system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are instantiated with ID and SiteID. Used for linking documents to sites.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page and class for administrating staff welcome actions in the application. It provides UI components for site and discipline filtering, date selection, error/warning display, and a grid view for employment applications.
purpose: To serve as an administrative welcome page for staff. Allows users to filter and view employment applications, manage disciplines and sites, display login information, and handle error/warning messages.

entities.name: WelcomeStaffAdmin
entities.description: Represents the administrative welcome page for staff.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Textbox for selecting the start date.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: Textbox for selecting the end date.

business_rules: Required fields must be filled for filtering.
Withdrawn applications are shown based on checkbox.
validations: CustomValidator checkStartEnd for date range validity.
conditions: Show Withdrawn applications if checkbox is checked.
system_behavior: Dropdowns and GridView data-bound on page load and filter change.
Handles AJAX postbacks for refreshing data.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing a code associated with a service, used for categorization and business logic in the system. Includes options for alternative language fields.
purpose: To categorize and manage service codes, provide lookup and selection functionality for courses and timetables.

entities.name: ServiceCode
entities.description: Represents a code for a specific service.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

workflows.name: Service Code Lookup and Selection
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID for codes by course.
Invoke ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID for codes by timetable.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, Name is set to NameAlt.
system_behavior: ServiceCode entities are populated from database procedures.
Localize function updates fields based on session language settings.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks historical changes and actions made to a site profile, capturing the nature of changes, user information, and agency details.
purpose: To provide audit history and traceability for changes to site profiles including who made the changes, when, and what fields were affected.

entities.name: SiteProfileHistory
entities.description: Represents a history entry for a change/action made to a site profile.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date and time of the action.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID who made the change.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if the change was made by a system admin.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Invoke SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Populate list of history entries for review/audit.

business_rules: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID is not the original user, show support team as actor.
Use alternative language fields if session indicates alt language.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields determines field selection during FillList.
system_behavior: SiteProfileHistory entities are filled from DB readers and procedures.
Audit entries capture action details, user/agency info, and phone as applicable.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is an entity for representing documents (files) attached to email popups. It tracks filenames, file paths, and deletion behavior.
purpose: To model email popup documents for selection, management, and deletion within the application.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the email popup document.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Flag indicating if the document is selected.

workflows.name: Email Popup Document Search
steps: Parse string to populate EmailPopupDocument list.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Call Delete with DataInfo and ID.
Delete file and directory from disk if possible.

business_rules: Deletion logic: Remove file and parent directory if exists.
conditions: DataInfo string must be non-empty for document search and deletion.
system_behavior: EmailPopupDocument entities are parsed from a DataInfo string.
Delete method handles file and directory deletion.
